title: Suikoden: Tendou Hyaku Hachi-sei
overview:
The towering fortress is our home. Onward, onward, to Liangshan Marsh.

A rogue monk of matchless strength, villainous women with bewitching smiles, mighty men who can even slay tigers - 108 heroes in boundless, heroic action. The second installment that vividly turns the Chinese classic "Water Margin" into a simulation game!!

The player becomes one of the heroes pursued by officials, manages the "fortress" that serves as their home, and aims to overthrow Gao Qiu, the treacherous minister throwing the country into chaos. The key is to invite the "outlaws" scattered across the land to join you, build up supplies and armaments to construct a mighty fortress, and raise your heroes' popularity by fighting rival forces. This is a title that everyone from simulation beginners to experts can fully enjoy, even those who don't know the original "Water Margin".

- The fun of building a humble "lair" into a splendid "strategic fortress" where outlaws from every province gather
- Fields being cultivated and buildings such as forts, smithies and taverns increasing are shown on the map in real time
- Turn-based battles allow a variety of attacks such as fire tactics and sorcery, and detailed strategies
- About 350 characters - outlaws, merchants, bandits, young girls - each with parameters such as skill, intellect and benevolence, and speaking lines that match their personalities
- Stunning opening and ending by Kimiya Masago
- Two scenarios with different selectable heroes and different situations surrounding the heroes
- 22 original BGM tracks (composed by Koji Tsunogo and others)

そびえる塞こそ、我らが故郷。いざ、いざ、梁山泊へ。

怪力無双の破戒坊主に、婉然と笑む悪女たち、虎をも倒す剛の者ら、一〇八人の好漢たちが縦横無尽の大活躍。
中国奇書『水滸伝』を鮮やかにSLG化した第2弾!!

プレイヤーは官吏に追われる好漢の一人となり、住処となる「要塞」の経営をはかり、国を乱す奸臣・高俅の打倒をめざします。野に散らばる「無頼漢」たちを仲間に誘い、物資や軍備を充実させて強大な要塞を築き、さらに敵対勢力と戦うことで好漢の人気を高めることがポイントです。SLG初心者から上級者まで、もちろん原典『水滸伝』を知らない方でも存分に楽しめる一本です。

●粗末な「ねぐら」を諸州の無頼漢が集う立派な「戦略要塞」に造り上げていく面白さ
●田畑の開墾される様子や、砦、鍛冶場、酒場など建築物が増えていくさまをリアルタイムでマップ上に表示
●火計や妖術などバラエティに富んだ攻撃が可能な戦闘は、緻密な作戦が可能なターン制
●無法者、商人、盗賊、小娘――技量、知力、仁愛などのパラメータをそなえ、性格に応じた台詞を吐く登場人物は約３５０人
●正子公也氏による超美麗オープニング・エンディング
●選べる好漢や、好漢達をめぐる状況も異なる２本のシナリオ
●オリジナルBGM全22曲（作曲／つのごうじ 他）
